column1: # coverage-accepted-removals.tsv -- justified outright deletions with NO re-home target,
# for the coverage-parity gate (consumed via 'coverage-parity.sh diff --accept').
# Distinct from a re-home: this records keyed assertions DELETED outright because what
# they asserted is already covered elsewhere by construction (e.g. a redundant nested
# peer-suite exit-code check whose peer already runs standalone via the run-all.sh
# glob, so there is no new key to name as a re-home target).
# A net-removed/reduced key is EXCUSED as an accepted removal iff it is listed below
# with a NON-EMPTY justification. This does not weaken the gate: the diff still flags
# every removal; the only pass route is an explicit, justified, human-reviewed entry
# Schema (TAB-separated, 4 fields); '#'-comment and blank lines are ignored:
# This forward-going list starts EMPTY. The 7 work-024 delivery-002 rows were relative
# to the pre-work-024 merge-base and are already absorbed into master, so they are NOT
# seeded here. Append one reviewed row per future accepted removal.
